title: Siren or horn warning while wearing headphones
setup: Clip the board where the microphone is uncovered. Give the rule a pin for a buzzer or vibration motor.

title: Bike rear camera, vehicle close behind
setup: Camera facing backwards under the saddle. Give the rule a pin for the rear light.

title: Backpack camera, someone close behind
setup: Camera facing backwards on the bag strap.

title: Person or vehicle ahead, buzz
setup: Camera facing forwards at chest height. Two rules, so two different buzz patterns are possible. An aid, not a replacement for a cane or a dog.

title: Indoors or outdoors
setup: Camera facing forwards. One rule for each state.

title: Umbrella reminder on stepping outside
setup: Camera facing forwards. Fires when the view is outdoors and rain is seen for 2 seconds.

rules.name: umbrella
rules.text: It is raining: take an umbrella

title: Life-log tags
setup: Camera facing forwards. Nothing is sent as it happens; minutes per tag come as one message a day.

title: Pause the music when someone speaks to you
setup: Board near your collar. Give the rule a pin wired to your player's pause input.

title: Conversation-time tracker that records nothing
setup: Board near your collar. Minutes of speech come as one message a day.

title: Cough counter
setup: Board near your collar. The count comes as one message a day. The model was not trained on sneezes.

title: Clap to trigger something
setup: Give the rule a pin. It pulses for half a second on each clap.

title: Commute detection from engine and train sounds
setup: Board in a bag pocket with the microphone uncovered. On after a minute of traffic or train noise.

title: Noise-exposure log near loud machines
setup: Board on your clothing. Minutes of machine and traffic sound come as one message a day. It classifies the sound; it does not measure decibels.

title: Screen-time tracker
setup: Camera facing forwards at chest or glasses height. Minutes with a screen in view come as one message a day.

title: Meal log
setup: Camera facing forwards. Each stretch with food in view counts as one meal.

title: Hiking, animal ahead
setup: Camera facing forwards. Give the rule a pin for a buzzer.

title: Camera trigger when a bird or animal is in frame
setup: Aim the board the same way as your camera and wire the rule's pin to the shutter release.

title: Bus arriving at the stop
setup: Camera looking up the road from the stop or a window. `vehicle_type` is one of the weaker answers; check it on your road.

title: Time-lapse only when the sky is clear
setup: Camera looking at the sky. Wire the rule's pin to your camera's enable or shutter input.

title: Something moves in view
setup: Fix the board so it does not shake, and point the camera at the place to watch. Any moving thing fires it, of any kind. Watch the Eye tab first to see what it follows in your room.

title: Something moves and it is not a person
setup: Point the camera at a room that should be still, for example where a pet is not allowed or where a robot vacuum runs. The model must also say that no person is in view.

rules.name: moving_no_person
rules.text: Something that is not a person is moving

title: A person who moves (not a photo or a poster)
setup: Point the camera at a door or a path. The model must see a person and the eye must see movement, so a picture of a person on a wall or a screen does not fire it.

rules.name: person_moving
rules.text: A person is moving in view

title: Something comes toward the camera
setup: Point the camera along a path, a corridor or a driveway, so that things come toward it and not across it. Look at eye_approach on the Live tab while you walk toward the board, and set the threshold below that.

rules.name: approaching
rules.text: Something is coming toward the camera

title: Something was moved, added or taken away
setup: Fix the board and point the camera at a shelf, a desk or a parking place. It fires when the picture stays different after the movement has stopped. A large change of light can also fire it.

rules.name: scene_changed
rules.text: Something in view was moved, added or taken away

title: The board itself was moved
setup: Fix the board. It fires when the whole picture moves for a second, which means that the camera was turned, knocked or carried away. A large thing that fills the view can also fire it.

title: Lights on while someone is in the room
setup: Point the camera at the room. The rule stays on for 5 minutes after the last sighting, so a pin can hold a light on.

title: Turn the TV off when nobody is watching
setup: Put the camera where it sees both the screen and the seats. Fires after 10 minutes with a screen in view and no person.

rules.name: tv_unwatched
rules.text: The TV has been on with nobody watching for 10 minutes

title: Desk lamp and monitor wake when you sit down
setup: Point the camera at your chair. On within a second of you sitting down, off a minute after you leave.

title: Someone lingering at the front door
setup: Point the camera at the doorstep. Someone walking past does not fire it; someone who stays 30 seconds does.

rules.name: lingering
rules.text: Someone has been at the door for 30 seconds

title: Car in the driveway
setup: Point the camera at the parking spot. The rule is on while a vehicle is seen.

title: Pet at the door
setup: Point the camera at the floor by the door or flap. `animal_type` is one of the weaker answers; check it sees your pet.

rules.name: cat_at_door
rules.text: The cat is at the door

rules.name: dog_at_door
rules.text: The dog is at the door

title: Bird at the feeder
setup: Point the camera at the feeder from close by. Visits are counted and reported once a day. Switch `photo` on to get a picture.

rules.name: bird
rules.text: A bird is at the feeder

title: Wildlife or pests in the garden
setup: Point the camera at the bed or lawn. Give the rule a pin to start a sprinkler valve.

rules.name: garden_animal
rules.text: An animal is in the garden

title: Hens back in the coop at dusk
setup: Put the camera inside the coop. Between 17:00 and 23:00 the rule turns on once animals have been seen for 5 seconds.

rules.name: hens_in
rules.text: The hens are in the coop

title: Knock on the door
setup: Put the board near the door, microphone uncovered. Give the rule a pin to flash a light.

title: Glass breaking
setup: Put the board in the room with the windows. Do not rely on it as an alarm; test it with a recording first.

title: Baby crying
setup: Put the board in the baby's room, a few metres from the cot.

title: Dog barking while you are out
setup: Put the board where the dog spends the day. Barks are counted and reported once a day; an alert comes at most every 10 minutes.

title: Tap or toilet left running
setup: Put the board in the bathroom or by the sink. Fires when running water has been heard for 5 minutes without a break.

rules.name: water_running
rules.text: Water has been running for 5 minutes

title: Washing machine has finished
setup: Put the board next to the machine. The alert comes when appliance noise that lasted at least 2 minutes has been gone for 3.

title: Coughing or snoring log at night
setup: Put the board on the bedside table. Nothing is sent as it happens; the counts come as one message a day.

title: Quiet-hours noise monitor
setup: Put the board in the room to watch. Between 22:00 and 07:00 it alerts when the room has not been quiet for 3 seconds.

title: Room in use, from speech
setup: Put the board in the meeting room. On while speech is heard and for 2 minutes after; give it a pin for a sign. No audio leaves the board.

title: It started raining
setup: Camera looking out of a window, or the board under a roof where rain is heard. Either sense can fire.

title: Skip the irrigation when it rains
setup: Camera looking at the sky or garden. The rule stays on for an hour after rain was seen; wire its pin to the controller's rain input.

title: Snow on the driveway
setup: Camera looking at the driveway in daylight.

title: Fog, switch the outdoor lights on
setup: Camera looking outdoors. Give the rule a pin for the lights.

title: Blinds down when sunny, up when overcast
setup: Camera looking at the sky. Two rules, one for each state; give each a pin.

title: Thunder heard
setup: Put the board near a window.

title: Wind picking up
setup: Put the board outdoors under cover, microphone facing the open. Give the rule a pin to retract an awning.

title: Nobody seen in the kitchen by 10 am
setup: Camera looking at the kitchen. Alerts at 10:00 if no person was seen since 06:00. One false sighting resets the wait, so test it for a few days before trusting it.

rules.name: no_morning
rules.text: Nobody has been seen in the kitchen this morning

title: A device that knows which room it is in
setup: Carry it or mount it; the rule for the room it sees turns on. `place` is right about two times in three.

title: Wake something only when it matters
setup: The rules' pins wake a bigger computer, a recorder or a modem. This firmware keeps its own Wi-Fi on; a build that sleeps between events has not been made.

title: Trail camera that keeps only the animal frames
setup: Camera on a tree or post. Each alert carries the frame the model saw (192x192). Photos leave the board with this recipe.

title: Room occupancy for heating and ventilation
setup: Camera looking at the room. On while people are seen and for 15 minutes after; give it a pin for the thermostat or fan. Minutes occupied come once a day.

title: Robot that follows or avoids people
setup: Camera on the robot facing forwards. The rule follows the answer with no delay; read its pin or the event lines on the robot's controller.

title: Toy that reacts to people, claps and voices
setup: Three rules, one pin each, for lights, a motor or a sound module.

title: Room occupied, from sound alone
setup: Board anywhere in the room, no camera needed. Any of speech, footsteps or general noise keeps it on for 5 minutes.

title: Shower or tap timer
setup: Board in the bathroom, away from spray. Alerts when water has run for 10 minutes; minutes of water come once a day.

rules.name: long_shower
rules.text: The water has been running for 10 minutes

title: Rain on the roof or window
setup: Board under the roof or by the window. Says when rain is heard, and counts minutes of rain a day. It does not tell light rain from heavy.

title: Movement in the room, from the Wi-Fi signal
setup: Put the board so that the room lies between it and the router. On while something moves and for 5 minutes after.

title: Movement at home while you are away
setup: Board and router on opposite sides of the rooms to cover. It does not know whether your phone is home; set the hours you are normally out, or change the rule when you leave. Pets, fans and people next door can fire it.

title: Movement downstairs at night
setup: As above, for the hours you are asleep. Put the board and the router in the rooms nobody should be in.

title: Smoke alarm beeping
question: smoke_alarm: [false, true]
record: true: your own alarm's test beep from several rooms and distances. false: the starter set plus other beeps at home (microwave, timer).

title: Doorbell, kettle or microwave beep
question: beep: [none, doorbell, kettle, microwave]
record: A few dozen clips of each of your own devices, at the distance the board will sit. none: the starter set.

title: Music playing
question: music: [false, true]
record: true: clips of the music you play, from your speakers, at several volumes. false: the starter set, speech and TV dialogue.

title: Parcel on the doorstep
question: parcel: [false, true]
record: true: boxes and bags on your doorstep, in different light. false: the empty doorstep at the same times of day, and people standing on it.

title: Mail in the mailbox
question: mail: [false, true]
record: Camera inside the box with a light. true: letters and leaflets in it. false: the empty box.

title: Garage door open or closed
question: garage_door: [closed, open]
record: Frames of the door in each state, day and night, with and without the car.

title: Window or door left open
question: window: [closed, open]
record: Frames of the window in each state, including tilted, with curtains in both positions.

title: Fridge door left open
question: fridge_door: [closed, open]
record: Frames of the fridge from where the board will sit, door closed and at several open angles. Add a rule with for_ms 120000.

title: Stove on with nobody in the kitchen
question: stove_on: [false, true]
record: true: pans on lit rings or glowing plates. false: the stove off, with and without pans. Combine in a rule with person_present != true.

title: Candle or fireplace left unattended
question: flame: [false, true]
record: true: the candle or fire lit, in dim and bright rooms. false: the same view unlit, and with lamps on. Combine with person_present != true.

title: Pet on the couch or the counter
question: pet_on_couch: [false, true]
record: true: your pet on the couch in several spots. false: the empty couch, people on it, the pet on the floor.

title: Pet bowl empty
question: bowl: [empty, has_food]
record: Frames looking down at the bowl, empty and at several fill levels.

title: Bins out on bin day
question: bins_out: [false, true]
record: Frames of the kerb with and without the bins, in different light and weather.

title: Plant wilting
question: plant: [fine, wilting]
record: Frames of the same plant watered and drooping. Expect to need many days of examples; the change is small.

title: 3D print failed
question: print: [fine, failed]
record: Frames of the bed during good prints and of spaghetti or a detached part. Failures are rare: collect them over time.

title: Puddle under the sink
question: puddle: [false, true]
record: Camera and a light under the sink. true: water on the floor, small and large. false: the dry floor.

title: A thud, then silence
question: thud: [false, true]
record: true: heavy objects dropped on your floors. false: the starter set, doors closing, footsteps. A rule can add the silence; it cannot tell a fall from a dropped box. Not a safety device.

title: A spoken command or wake word
question: command: [none, your_word]
record: A hundred or more clips of the word from the people who will say it, near and far. none: the starter set and other speech. Teaching a new word has not been measured.

title: Your name called
question: my_name: [false, true]
record: As for a wake word: your name said by several people, and other speech as false.

title: Keys, wallet, bag in view when leaving
question: item: [none, keys, wallet, bag]
record: Frames of each item on the shelf by the door, alone and together, and the empty shelf.

title: Crossing light red or green
question: crossing: [none, red, green]
record: Frames of crossing lights in each state from where you would stand, day and night. Do not use it to decide when to cross.

title: A hand sign in front of the camera
question: sign: [none, open_hand, fist, thumbs_up]
record: Fifty or more frames of each sign at arm's length against several backgrounds, and frames with no hand.

title: Reading, screen or distance
question: looking_at: [far, screen, page]
record: Frames from a forward-facing camera while reading a book, using a screen and looking across a room or outdoors.

title: Shelf empty, queue present, item on the conveyor
question: state: [empty, present]
record: Frames of your own shelf, queue or belt in each state from the fixed camera position.

title: Helmet or hi-vis worn
question: helmet: [none, no_helmet, helmet]
record: Frames of people with and without the gear at the distance of the gate, and frames with nobody.

title: A machine that sounds wrong
question: machine: [normal, fault]
record: Many minutes of the machine running normally, and every faulty run you can get. Likely needs a fine-tune (`decidio run`), not a quick teach.

title: Beehive sound state
question: hive: [normal, queenless, swarming]
record: Recordings from inside the hive in each state. Likely needs a fine-tune (`decidio run`).

title: Someone at the desk, from typing
question: typing: [false, true]
record: true: your keyboard from where the board sits. false: the starter set and the room's other sounds.

title: Door opened or closed, by its sound
question: door: [none, opened, closed]
record: Clips of your own door opening and closing, gently and firmly. none: the starter set and footsteps.

title: A knock or tap pattern as a switch
question: tap: [none, double_tap]
record: Clips of your pattern on the actual table, and of single knocks and other bumps as none.

title: Fridge, heating or pump running
question: running: [false, true]
record: Clips with the compressor or pump on and off, from where the board will sit. A rule with `count: daily` gives minutes running.

title: Pan boiling over, kettle boiling
question: boiling: [false, true]
record: Clips of a rolling boil and of water hissing on the hob. false: simmering, frying and kitchen talk.
